title: Item 18 · After the testing day: results, print and CSV
subtitle: Approved in each section; one part was left for later. After a testing day, Star has a Results tab with result tags, Print results, an admin-only CSV of the whole event and Email result. Color Belt types results straight into its Grading tab and prints a grading sheet as the paper backup; a printed results list was left as “a later, separate decision” (v0.189), a CSV was never discussed, and there is no email because Color Belt's form asks names only (v0.132). The words differ: Color Belt “Pass / Not passed / No show”, Star “Passed / Make-up / Not finished”. Black Belt already plans Star's shape — Candidates · Grading · Results (its plan; contract 0025 approved on its branch, not merged yet). (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

items.caption: 1. Star's Results tab (v0.143, v0.144, v0.514): result tags (“Passed”, “Make-up”, “Not finished”), Print results, Download CSV (admins only), Email result and Mark as sent.

2. Color Belt: results are typed straight into Grading — “Pass / Not passed / No show” — and “Print grading sheet” is the paper backup for the day (v0.182, v0.189). After the testing: no results print, no CSV, no email.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one results pattern

items.caption: 3. Color Belt with option B: Star's Print results and Download CSV next to the class switch (Star has them next to its Dan switch), and the result button says “Passed”, Star's word. Results stay in Grading — Color Belt types them in directly, so it needs no Results tab.

columns.note: One results pattern (B): the same word where a result means the same (“Passed”); after any testing day each testing section can print its results (who passed to which belt, a page per class) and admins can download a CSV of the event; Email result and Mark as sent only where the form collects an email (Star, and Black Belt, whose planned Results tab is Star's shape). Picture 3 is drawn over the real Grading tab; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: one results pattern for the testing sections?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − after a color belt testing there is no way to print or export who passed; “Pass” and “Passed” for the same result.
B · Recommended: one results pattern (picture 3). Color Belt gets Star's Print results and an admin-only Download CSV and says “Passed”; Black Belt's planned Results tab already fits; Email result only where the form collects an email. + after any testing the desk can print who passed to which belt, for belts and certificates; one way to do it in every section. − a new print layout and a CSV for Color Belt (copied from Star's); the CSV holds families' payments, so admins only.
C · Only the word: Color Belt says “Passed”; no print or CSV. + almost no work. − the after-testing gap stays, and v0.189's deferred decision stays open.
